content.markdown: The top-level control surface for a `.SNL_Doc/` workspace. Opened via `SNL: Open Dashboard`. Renders four collapsible sections (Entry Kinds, SNL Macros, Entries, Libraries) with a dashed `+` AddBar at the tail of each list for creating new items. Serves as the single hub — no tree-view sidebar competes with it.

Legacy top-level infoview that lists all entries and lets the user pick one to render inline. Kept as a gateway into per-entry infoviews; Ctrl+click on an entry title spawns a dedicated `Entry Infoview` panel.

Dedicated per-entry panel (one instance per entryId, tab title `SNL — <entry title>`). Renders the entry via `EntryRender` with SNL body and hover-popover recursion for macro references. Opened via `snlDoc.openEntryInfoview <entryId>` or Ctrl+click a title anywhere.

Modal-style panel to seed a new `libraries/<slug>/` tree. Takes a title, slugifies to the directory name, writes empty `meta.json` + `graph.json` (+ `counters.json` after the counter refactor). Never overwrites — `duplicate` result if the slug exists.

The Library detail/edit view. Hosts the outline tree editor over `graph.json` and (after the counter refactor) the Counters tree editor over `counters.json`. Watches `entries.json`, `graph.json`, and `counters.json` for external edits to stay in sync. Ctrl+click on an entry-ref title jumps to that entry's Infoview.

Panel to author a single entry: id (manual with `Generate UUID` button), kind, title, and content across five format tabs (SNL, Typst, LaTeX, Markdown, plain). Persists to the shared `entries.json` pool. When invoked from a Library outline with a typed-but-unresolved id, seeds the id field so save-then-return resolves the stub.
Panel to declare a new EntryKind (id, name, stroke/background colors, default counter name, style). Values persist to `config.json#entry_kinds`.
Empty-catalog bootstrap panel with a Presets dropdown (currently only `Fulcrum's Math Notes`) that seeds 12 EntryKinds in one write. Skipped if the catalog is already non-empty.
Edit-mode variant of `Create Entry Kind`, keyed by kind id. Same field set. Renaming the kind name does NOT rewrite existing entries that reference it by id.
Panel to declare a MacroKind (id, name, description, coloring). Macro kinds carry no numbering. Persists to `config.json#macro_kinds`.
Empty-catalog bootstrap for macro kinds. Analog to Init Entry Kinds — presets seed a starter set in a single write.
Edit-mode variant of `Create Macro Kind`, keyed by kind id.
Panel to create a new `term_macros/<slug>.json` package: title and initial (possibly empty) macro list. Slug derived from title.

The macro-package detail view — table of macros in one `term_macros/*.json` file. Supports select-mode multi-select with batch ops (Package as new / Move to package… / Delete), active-toggle header, per-row Edit, and package-picker with inline `New macro package` creation.

Panel to author a single macro: name, kind, and multi-format renderer templates (KaTeX-React, SNL-native, others). Live preview using the arg-placeholder macros. Inline package-picker lets you create the target package here without leaving the panel.

Edit-mode variant of Create Macro. Also hosts the GUI inductive editor — a row-tree editor for the `SnlSyntaxTree` payload of macros whose renderer uses `snl-native` templates. Only `()` and `[]` are managed by the editor; sigils (`@`, `%`, `$`) are literal per author authoring convention.
Panel to declare a semantic relationship between two entries (from, to, label). Persists to `.SNL_Doc/relationships.json`.
Edit-mode variant of Create Relationship, keyed by relationship id.

Visualization of the pool-wide (or library-scoped) semantic graph — entries as nodes, relationships as directed edges. Two scopes: `snlDoc.openInfoviewGraph` (whole pool) and `snlDoc.openInfoviewGraphForLibrary` (single library).
Full-text search over entries + macros + libraries. Opened via `SNL: Open SNoogL (Search)`. Independent panel — not embedded in Dashboard.

Dashboard section listing declared EntryKinds. Empty → single AddBar `+ Initialize Entry Kinds`. Non-empty → table (name / stroke swatch / default counter name / edit-row) plus tail AddBar `+ Create Entry Kind`.
Dashboard section listing `term_macros/*.json` packages. Table columns: title / macro count / active toggle / actions.
Dashboard section listing all entries in the shared pool. Table (preview swatch / title / id / kind / formats populated). Empty and expanded → AddBar `+ Create Entry`. Only visible when expanded.
Dashboard section listing libraries discovered by disk walk of `.SNL_Doc/libraries/`. Rows link to Edit Library.

The tree-view editor over `graph.json` inside Edit Library. Each row = entry-ref node with `Button`-based row toolbar (↑/↓ move, indent, outdent, add child, add sibling, delete). Add form supports resolving-typed-id and — post-refactor — inserts stub + jumps to Create Entry when the id doesn't yet resolve.

Post-refactor: the tree-view editor over `counters.json` inside Edit Library. Same tree UI as the Outline. Each counter = `{ id, name, numbering DSL, children[] }`. EntryKinds refer to counters here by `defaultCounterName`; per-entry-ref override lives in the outline row.
In `Create Entry` next to the ID field. Fills the field with `crypto.randomUUID()`. Re-labels to `Regenerate UUID` when the field is non-empty.
Full-width dashed `+ Create X` bar at the end of a Dashboard list or an empty section. Hover flips to a solid focused border. Keyboard-activatable (Enter/Space).
↑ button in the row toolbar of a tree-view editor. Moves the current row above its previous sibling within the same parent. No-op at position 0.
Indent button. Makes the current row the last child of its previous sibling. No-op if there is no previous sibling.
Outdent button. Promotes the current row to the next sibling of its parent. No-op at the root level.
Deletes the current row (and its subtree in tree editors). No confirmation modal — the tree state is source-controlled.
Manual-input text field for a new entry's id. Semantic ids recommended; use `Generate UUID` for anonymous ones. Uniqueness in the shared pool enforced by the host on save.
Free text. Displayed in the entry header (`<KindName> -- <Title>` or with counter label prefix inside a Library context).

Typst-inspired DSL string on a Counter (post-refactor) or, before the refactor, on an EntryKind. Examples: `1`, `.1`, `A`, `(i)`, `Ex. A.`, `§I.`. `formatNumbering(template, k)` yields the k-th label.

The extension registers 32 `snlDoc.*` commands (see `package.json #contributes.commands`). Categories: init (`init`, `initEntryKinds`, `initMacroKinds`), create (`create*`), edit (`edit*`), delete (`delete*`), open panels (`openInfoview`, `openDashboard`, `openEntryInfoview`, `openMacroPackage`, `openSnoogL`, `openInfoviewGraph[ForLibrary]`), and utilities (`refreshInfoview`, `revealEntryPointer`, `regenerateDependencies`). Most create/edit commands take zero args from the palette and launch a webview panel; programmatic-only variants (like `openEntryInfoview`) are gated with `when: false` in the palette contribution.

Bootstraps `.SNL_Doc/` in the current workspace root. Writes `config.json` (v0.0.3), empty `entries.json`, empty `term_macros/` and `libraries/` directories. `exists` result when already initialized (no overwrite).
Opens (or reveals) the singleton Dashboard panel. Beside column. Reads current config + entries + libraries on ready.
Programmatic-only. Given an entryId, opens or reveals a dedicated Entry Infoview panel keyed by that id. Dispatched by Ctrl+click on any rendered entry title.
Scans all entries for macro references and rebuilds the dependency subset of `.SNL_Doc/relationships.json`. Non-dependency relationships are preserved.
